role: The daylight sensor's block entity: every 20 ticks it asks the block to recompute its metadata from the sky light and the sun angle.
scope_reason: Daylight sensors can be crafted and placed; the metadata update still runs with redstone off (it is block state, not power delivery).

members.name: updateEntity
members.note: includes BlockDaylightDetector.func_149957_e; cov-place-s1 places a sensor and runs 60 ticks of it

notes: detector_update reads the celestial angle from a recorded per-tick table (tileticks_set_time); in a whole-server run the caller must supply it.
